# Queue as sample of the product

`customer_support.mm.queue_management.queue_as_sample_of_the_product` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> The queue is the highest-fidelity, worst-organised product research the company owns.

It is a continuous census of what customers could not do by themselves. Treating it only as a workload to be cleared throws away the one dataset that would reduce the workload.
